topic: The 5-minute daily habit your heart will thank you for

hook.text: Five minutes. That's all your heart is asking for.

beats.text: A brisk five-minute walk after meals gets your heart pumping and helps your body handle blood sugar.
Adults need about 150 minutes of moderate activity a week. Short walks count, and they add up fast.
Brisk means you can talk, but not sing. Start with one walk a day, then build from there.

cta: Save this, and take your first five-minute walk today.
